tier3_constraints.constraint_text: must record financial transactions including income and expenses
tier3_constraints.reasoning: Ensuring accurate recording of financial transactions relates to the reliability of the system.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: must support multiple accounts and categories
tier3_constraints.reasoning: This relates to the functional suitability of the system, ensuring it meets business requirements.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: Users must be able to generate financial reports such as balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements
tier3_constraints.reasoning: The ability to generate reports relates to the usability of the system for end-users.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: must ensure double-entry bookkeeping principles are followed
tier3_constraints.reasoning: Following double-entry principles is crucial for the reliability and correctness of financial data.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: maintain an audit trail of all transactions
tier3_constraints.reasoning: Maintaining an audit trail ensures integrity and auditability of financial transactions.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: must support multiple currencies and handle currency conversion
tier3_constraints.reasoning: Handling multiple currencies relates to the functional suitability of the system.
